name: IRIS National Fair (Initiative for Research & Innovation in STEM)
focusAreas: STEM Research, Engineering, AI, Life Sciences (ISEF Pathway)
howToApply: Submit an original research synopsis via irisnationalfair.org to qualify for Regeneron ISEF. Verify current rules on the official site.

name: CBSE Regional & National Science Exhibition
focusAreas: Science & Technology for Society, Computational Thinking, Health
howToApply: Register through your school science coordinator on the official CBSE Academic portal.

name: IIT Hyderabad / IIIT-H Student Outreach & Young Researchers
focusAreas: AI/ML, Robotics, Embedded Systems, Human-Centered Computing
howToApply: Monitor IIIT-H & IITH outreach announcements for high-school bootcamps and lab visits.

name: INSPIRE Awards – MANAK (DST, Govt. of India)
howToApply: Nominate original ideas through your school headmaster on the E-MIAS portal.
